description: A list of numbers and a set of strings unify to a list of numbers
notes: The spec unifies a list of numbers and a set of strings to a list of strings (list and set give list, number and string give string), so this should give ["x"]. hashicorp/hcl picks the list of numbers because an unsafe conversion to it from the set of strings exists (unify in cty/convert/unify.go), and converting "x" to a number then fails. With the kinds swapped it works (unify-set-and-list-unifies-element-types).
reference_error: false result value has the wrong type
